name: soft-studio
summary: Tactile studio look: cream base, a cover-derived pastel per scene, soft-black type in Gmarket Sans, real CSS-3D books with soft contact shadows, paper grain, UI mockups and hand-drawn marks. Continuous transitions (iris/blinds/blob) instead of hard cuts. No HUD, no label boxes.
font_line: Gmarket Sans 700/500/300 (embedded OTF, Korean) / Outfit 700 (Latin) / Space Mono 400/700 (UI mockups, numerals)
